messages:
alyssa (PM): quick sync on automatic fallback UX — want safe defaults and clear inspection. thinking: reason, sample failures, and an easy undo.
max (Eng): yes. runtime can flip routing, but we need an audit object with the trigger payload. what signals should be canonical?
jorge (SRE): combo signals: sustained 5xx rate OR p95 latency spike OR validation failures. require two of: (signal, duration) pairs in noisy infra.
maya (Design): operators want a single-line verdict in console + expandable detail. risk: too many metrics confuse them.
sam (Infra): also require cooldown windows to avoid oscillation. API should expose POST /rollouts/{id}/override for manual revert + reason.
alyssa (PM): for notification model: slack banner + console notice usually. page only if fallback persists > 15m and affects enterprise customers.
max (Eng): runtime will emit autofallback events: {route, from, to, trigger, window_sec, metrics}. control plane adds route config and customer tier.
maya (Design): UI idea: collapsed card shows "Auto-fallback: route /chat -> small-model (latency)". expand reveals sparkline + 3 sample failed responses (redacted).
jorge (SRE): samples must be redacted automatically. add sampling cap: 1 sample/minute/route and scrub PII fields.
sam (Infra): agreed. also include kernel_variant and model_checksum in audit for repro.
max (Eng): debate: control plane should create a read-only rollout or do a full rollout object that operators can edit?
alyssa (PM): prefer a read-only audit rollout plus a suggested patch operators can accept. safer and auditable.
jorge (SRE): add derived metric fallback_rate_by_route and keep traces for 45d for investigations.
maya (Design): timeline view: trigger -> switch -> samples -> operator action. add quick actions: "Open replay", "Force revert (dry_run)".
max (Eng): we should rate-limit autofallback creation to avoid log storms during cascading failures. e.g., max one autofallback per route per 10m.
sam (Infra): implement override API with dry_run flag that appends audit note but doesn't change routing.
alyssa (PM): action items: max spec event enrichment + rate limit, jorge SRE runbook + pager rules, maya mockups, sam API stub.
max (Eng): will drop schema doc and sample queries.
jorge (SRE): will draft runbook and thresholds and post to eng-oncall.
maya (Design): mockups by Wed EOD, including the redaction UX.
sam (Infra): open PR for override endpoint prototype.
alyssa (PM): one last edge: if model validation fails correlate with prompt drift. max: hook eval pipeline to flag distribution shift.
max (Eng): noted. will add prompt-hash snapshot to audit when available.
jorge (SRE): also require stable window of 2m before switching back to avoid flip-flop.
alyssa (PM): thanks all. I'll update the RFC and tag reviewers.
maya (Design): :thumbsup:
max (Eng): :+1:
jorge (SRE): ack
sam (Infra): ack
